newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shoe maker Pegasus seen in HK$195 mln IPO -sources.
newsitem.headline: Shoe maker Pegasus seen in HK$195 mln IPO -sources.

text.p: Taiwanese-owned sports shoes manufacturer Pegasus Holdings Ltd is expected to issue 180 million new shares at HK$1.08 per share in its initial public offering of shares, market sources said.
Pegasus which makes NIKE sports shoes under licence, is seen raising capital to fund expansion of its manufacturing plant in China's Guangdong province, sources said.
Sources said the flotation is expected to open in early October and dealing in shares is expected to begin in mid of October.
Yuantai Securities is the sponsor of the issue, sources added.
Pegasus is expected to hold an analyst presentation on Thursday.
